bands.label: Where you stand
bands.title: Start with the fundamentals.
bands.text: There are real gaps here — which is useful to know. A short free course will close most of them fast, and the live cohort gives you structure if self-study never sticks.

bands.label: Where you stand
bands.title: You know the basics. Now get the reps.
bands.text: You're past the beginner stage but it isn't automatic yet. The self-paced course turns this into something you use at work without thinking about it.

bands.label: Where you stand
bands.title: Strong. Time to go deeper.
bands.text: You've got a working grasp of this. The next gain comes from harder material and real projects rather than more fundamentals.
